task.title: Independently verify the T38 fix-review dispositions and open findings
task.description: Adversarially verify the wave-A dispositions for F-001..F-013 and every open finding raised by the five reviewers. You did not write the fixes and did not write the reviews.
task.scope: Read-only verification across apps/cli, apps/relay and packages, plus the T38 review artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: Each of the ten OPEN findings receives a verdict of confirmed, refuted or unverifiable, with the evidence that produced it. Open findings: HL-N-001 (major), BE-R-001, BE-R-002, SEC-R-001, HL-N-002, HL-N-003, T38-TP-001, T38-TP-002, T38-TP-003, T38-L-001 (all minor).

HL-N-001 gets the deepest scrutiny because it is the only open major and it drives a fix wave: confirm or refute that a single envelope from an unpinned sender permanently wedges a recipient mailbox, that /v1/messages/send accepts it without sender authentication, and that ackPending is unreachable once the batch throws. State whether messages queued behind it are actually lost.

The reviewers' `fixed` dispositions for the five blockers and F-001/F-002/F-003 are spot-checked adversarially: pick the claims whose failure would be most damaging and try to break them, rather than re-reading the same evidence.

The testing-practices claim that `strict:false` leaves all sixteen F-013 tests green (mutation MC10) is independently reproduced or refuted, because the orchestrator relied on those guards as the defence against an over-correction and needs to know whether that reliance was justified.
Any reviewer claim that does not survive verification is reported as refuted with the reasoning, not quietly dropped.
A short recommendation per confirmed finding: fix now in this flow, or record as a documented prototype limitation.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; project root is /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet.
You are an INDEPENDENT verifier. You did not write these fixes and you did not write these reviews. Do not accept a reviewer's conclusion because it is well argued - reproduce it or refute it.
Adversarial stance: your job is to try to BREAK the claims, especially the `fixed` dispositions on the five blockers. A disposition you merely re-read is not verified.

Bounded read-only probes and temporary scratch files outside the repository are allowed. Any mutation inside the repository must be reverted and verified byte-identical, and reported explicitly. Prefer probes that need no mutation at all.
Do not permanently modify any source, test or configuration file. Do not fix anything.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Use `keryx ctx rg` for searches, never bare rg/grep. Use `keryx ctx run` for long command output.
Never print plaintext message bodies, ciphertext, profile store keys, private key material or HTTP request bodies - describe by location and mechanism only.
Do not commit and do not create a branch, PR or remote. The repository is on unborn `main` with everything untracked, so an empty `git diff` is NOT an empty change set.
Respect prototype scope: a local computer CLI prototype. Do not confirm findings that merely demand production hardening, mobile support, deployment or external audit.

Write a valid subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/reviews/2026-09-06-fixreview-echolet-cli-prototype-t38/review-verifier-result.json and a report to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/reviews/2026-09-06-fixreview-echolet-cli-prototype-t38/review-verifier-report.md, and make the final response start with STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: T38 managed fix review: independent verification before any fix wave is committed.
